authority: User explicitly rejected a minimal testnet check and requested substantive enterprise-grade trading-tool development. This campaign uses only virtual Spot-testnet orders; no live-money, mainnet, futures, Polymarket, transfer or unrelated-account authority.
question: Can durable owned client IDs support resting-limit cancellation and IOC buy/unwind cycles with exact trade cash reconciliation across all three assets, without duplicate submissions or foreign-state mutation?

per_asset: Confirm no foreign open orders; never cancel those orders
Submit one LIMIT_MAKER BUY at tick-rounded 99 percent of observed bid, quantity rounded down toward at most 100 virtual USDT
Discard acknowledgement body, reload hash-chained journal, query exact owned order, cancel it if still active, reconcile authenticated fills
Close any acquired campaign base through at most three total IOC sells per symbol
Submit one LIMIT IOC BUY capped at tick-rounded 100.2 percent of observed ask and at most 100 virtual USDT; ignore acknowledgement body and reconcile the durable client ID
Unwind only net acquired campaign base using tick-rounded 99.5 percent of current bid, exact step rounding and at most three total closes per symbol
Final per-symbol open-order and exact owned-quantity checks
design.partial_fills: Reconcile if observed; do not manufacture them or claim unobserved behavior was tested. Synthetic partial-fill fee tests are distinct evidence.
design.restart_scope: Reload persistent journal while an order may rest. This is not a cold process restart or actual packet-drop test.

USER_DATA_GET: /api/v3/openOrders exact symbol counts only for foreign rows
TRADE: POST /api/v3/order LIMIT_MAKER or LIMIT IOC with EXPIRE_TAKER only

failure_policy: Stop new entries on failure. Never resubmit an attempted POST. A separate recover invocation may reconcile the same durable intents and close only their acquired base; it may not create a new buy. Preserve original journal/results. No blanket cancellation, foreign-inventory rounding, funds injection or alternate host.
success: All three assets must source-prove resting NEW, cancellation CANCELED, nonzero buy and sell fills, zero net owned base and no remaining open orders. Report separate coverage flags; workflow completion alone is not coverage success.
retention: Hash-chained durable pre-request and outcome journals; normalized public configuration, typed owned-order/trade views and cash ledger. Never retain keys, signed URLs/headers, raw private responses, account identifiers, absolute balances, free-form exchange errors or foreign order details. This is not origin-HTTP-byte replay.
credentials: Masked transient getpass input only, no script literals, argv, environment persistence or credential files. Process exit releases memory, without claiming secure erasure.
preflight: Twelve focused offline checks passed, including stateful three-asset venue simulation, lost acknowledgement without resubmission, foreign-state denial, quantity grids, journal tampering and partial-fill fee accounting. Ruff and module help passed.
